abstract: For every integer $m\ge4$, we prove that the saddle-shaped solution of the Allen--Cahn equation in $\R^{2m}$ constructed by Cabr\'e and Terra \cite{CabreTerra2009} is a global minimizer. Moreover, up to sign, it is the unique global minimizer whose nodal set at infinity is a normal graph over the Simons cone with a height that decays faster than that of the Hardt--Simon leaves.
hook: The saddle-shaped Allen-Cahn solution in dimensions 8 and up is a true global minimizer, and a unique one
summary: The paper proves that a known saddle-shaped solution of the Allen-Cahn equation (a model of phase boundaries) in R^2m, m at least 4, minimizes energy globally. It is also the only global minimizer, up to sign, whose boundary approaches the Simons cone with faster-than-Hardt-Simon decay. The proof covers even dimensions 8 and higher only.
title: A uniqueness theorem for Allen--Cahn global minimizers asymptotic to the Simons cone
